text:
deploy-bot: Created release candidate v2.14.0-rc3 (sha: abc123def). Change window scheduled 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC. Pin requested by @Marta.
Marta: quick dry-run in staging went green, smoke tests + kv warm ok.
Sam: thanks — can we confirm rollback steps and who is sheriff for the window?
Devon: Sheriff will be @Alex-Oncall for 22:00UTC. I added rollback playbook to the PR.
Alex-Oncall: ack, I'm oncall and available for the window. share rollback commands pls.
Devon: rollback commands below — tested in staging dry run:
```bash
# rollback to previous stable
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:v2.13.7
# scale back new RC replicas to 0
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-rc3 --replicas=0
# verify KV cache warmers: api call /_health/kvcache
```
Sam: will add a short release note blurb and PR link. tagging @Marta for release notes approval.
Marta: release notes ok, added line about model-quantization toggle and known perf delta on long-seq.
ci-cd-bot: deploy candidate v2.14.0-rc3 built and artifacts pinned at gcr.io/redwood/inference:rc3-abc123def.
Devon: ops checklist attached in thread (kv-warm, smoke, traffic-shim). Plan: canary 5% for 10m, monitor P95 latency & error-rate, then step to 50% if metrics stable.
Sam: telemetry assertions: P95 < 1200ms, error-rate < 0.5% (5-min rolling). I'll watch dashboards.
Marta: final signoff from product: ✅. Proceed with promotion at 22:00UTC unless any blocker reported.
Alex-Oncall: I'll trigger the promo and be ready to execute rollback commands if alerts fire.
Devon: note — if we hit latency regressions, rollback and open postmortem with eval prompt set.
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z. Notifying oncall and release channel.
ci-cd-bot: dry-run deploy performed at 21:30UTC — no anomalies observed.
Sam: leaving a short runbook in the release PR with the exact rollback snippet and alert thresholds.
Marta: thanks all — locking the candidate now (artifact pinned). :lock: 
Alex-Oncall: ready. See you at 22:00.
ci-cd-bot: Reminder in 30m: promotion window starts in 30 minutes.
